intro: Armenia is a parliamentary republic, led by a prime minister chosen by parliament.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister leads the government; the president is ceremonial. After peaceful protests in 2018, Nikol Pashinyan became prime minister.

chapters.title: Changing allies
text: Armenia long relied on Russia for security, but has moved closer to Europe since losing Karabakh.
